column1: # Campaign 22 client-go test evidence for txnkv-physical-channel-evidence-runtime.

column8: A pending request publishes immutable physical address, channel version, stream generation, and forwarded target before completion. The complete upstream async request matrix remains open.
Per-attempt publication remains attached through deferred completion without consulting mutable pool state. Full Go context attachment and tracing parity remain open.
The bounded async transport retains caller deadline and cancellation ownership while request handles cannot close the worker. The exhaustive timeout race matrix remains open.
Cloneable request handles share dispatch authority but cannot perform process shutdown; the unique owner explicitly closes and joins. Full client-go handle-close compatibility remains open.
Owner cancellation prevents new work and explicit shutdown observes command and worker termination failures. The complete before-send close race matrix remains open.
Physical channel identity is public, immutable, nonzero, and distinct from BatchCommands stream generation. The full connection-pool construction matrix remains open.
The sole owner closes the worker and cloned handles cannot acquire shutdown authority. Full post-close connection lookup parity remains open.
Caller cancellation and bounded timeout remain terminal at the request leaf while explicit owner shutdown stays inspectable. The complete upstream error-code and timing matrix remains open.
Replacement physical channels receive new versions and pending BatchCommands evidence does not alias the replacement generation. The full reconnect and backoff matrix remains open.
BatchCommands publication preserves physical dispatch and logical forwarded host as separate immutable fields. The full metadata, resource-control, and command payload matrix remains open.
A reopened retained stream gets a distinct generation and stale completions cannot satisfy replacement in-flight entries. Live restart stress and all reconnect policies remain open.
Cloneable handles can overlap bounded submissions through one process-owned worker, and shutdown authority remains unique. Full client-go admission and overload parity remain open.
Forwarded pending requests preserve both physical channel version and logical target across stream replacement. Randomized multi-store restart and long-running forwarding stress remain open.
Closed-owner and caller-cancelled requests fail without granting handles close or join authority. The full fast-fail classification and overload matrix remain open.
Connection errors and successful publications expose the same physical address and version identity shape. The complete client-go connection error taxonomy remains open.
Unavailable transport ownership fails explicitly and shutdown retains command-channel and worker failures. Full pool availability scoring and fast-fail timing parity remain open.

Explicit shutdown joins once and returns typed command, missing-acknowledgement, and worker-panic failures without first-error loss; Drop is only containment. The complete concurrent close stress matrix remains open.
